notes.title: Path Viewer Update!
notes.content:
We're introducing the "Path Viewer". This new menu will allow you to replay scenes featuring a specific romantic interest (Currently Megan, Betty and Kimmy). As you play through the game, these scenes will unlock. Just load your latest save and look for the "Path Viewer" menu.

Replay the girls' key moments with the press of a button. Simply select a character and relive their story at any time!

Hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
It's now possible to automatically unlock the relationship paths with all the girls! This will work even after having passed the in-game choices that lead to these paths.

Just load your save file and press the "Unlock all paths" button on the game menu.
[i](Make sure to save your game after clicking this button).[/i]

notes.title: Big Announcement
notes.content:
We would like to announce that [i][b]Hunter: Space Pirates[/b][/i] is going [b]FREE TO PLAY[/b]!

After much thought, Mr. Mister and team, has decided that making the base game a free experience will be the best course of action, as well as reducing the price for the Chapter 2 DLC. These changes will happen on January 13.

We appreciate all the support you have given us! Without it we wouldn't have been able to continue developing this game.

If you bought the game previous to this change, you will get a chance to redeem a special achievement available to those who supported us from the beginning. [b]You'll just need to open the game to get this achievement! [/b]We're also planning on including exclusive renders attached to it.
[b](THIS ACHIEVEMENT WILL ONLY BE AVAILABLE UNTIL JANUARY 12)[/b]

After these changes happen, we will make available a supporter DLC for the old price. This DLC will have the same effect. So if you didn't get a chance to redeem it, please contact us on our support email to resolve the issue.

To end this announcement, we would like to thank you again for giving our game a chance. If you enjoyed it consider leaving a review to help us reach more people!

- Mr. Mister and team

notes.title: Chapter 1 Extension Update Now Live!
notes.content:
The wait is over! We're thrilled to announce that the Chapter 1 Extension update of [i][b]Hunter: Space Pirates[/b][/i] is now available.

Continue your journey from where you left off at the end of Chapter 1, and dive deeper into the story with new characters that will to capture your attention. Plus, you'll have the opportunity to further develop your relationship with Betty!

Thank you for your continued support – we can't wait to hear your thoughts. Jump back in and experience the next chapter today!
